description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_NewHire" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/new-hire">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NewHire" name="New Hire Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for new hire identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for new hire">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Selected_Split" name="Candidate selected?" default="Flow_NotSelected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotSelected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotSelected" name="Candidate not selected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotSelected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCandidate" name="Invite selected candidate to interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Format_Split" name="Candidate's interview preference?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InPerson</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Virtual</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InPerson</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Virtual</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Format_Join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_NoNegotiation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoNegotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Negotiate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation_Join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoNegotiation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_OfferAccepted" messageRef="Message_OfferAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Orientation" name="Conduct orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Conduct training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated into team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Gateway_Selected_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Selected_Split" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidateSelected == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSelected" sourceRef="Gateway_Selected_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidate" targetRef="Gateway_Format_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson" sourceRef="Gateway_Format_Split" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'in-person'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_Format_Split" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'virtual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_Format_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_Format_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Format_Join" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${salaryNegotiation == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
